dedupe_keys.name: aerial power infrastructure detection dataset v2 2

description: The Aerial Power Infrastructure Detection Dataset provides UAV top-view images of medium-voltage distribution poles in Cyprus with labelled T-shaped crossbars. The canonical Zenodo release is version 2.2 from March 2023, with train, validation and test archives plus annotations. Its own metadata describes images taken across seasons, backgrounds and UAV heights for pole detection and localisation in power-network inspection. The Dataset Ninja GitHub mirror supplies conversion scripts, summary metadata and a separate download route. There is a count inconsistency: the Zenodo table totals 14,919 images and 13,831 labelled T-bars, while the mirror summary swaps those totals. The source archives would need inspection before using split sizes. Coverage is selected Cyprus pole imagery, not a full asset inventory or coordinates for a distribution network. The provider states CC BY 4.0 and free public access. Simulation use includes testing image-based inspection before a network-condition or maintenance model; it does not directly provide failures or degradation rates. It relates to data-gmns only as an upstream asset-detection input, not network topology. No archive was downloaded.
name: Aerial Power Infrastructure Detection Dataset v2.2
notes: G8; G8-0649. Metadata and documentation checked. Data payloads and software execution were not tested. Simulation uses are curator interpretations.
